REGULAR MEETING AND ADJOURNED SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - APRIL 23, 2020 -
07:00 P.M.
TELECONFERENCE MEETING AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20 VIA ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID # 727 2058 4075
*COVID-19 NOTICE*
To protect public health and safety during the local, state, and federally declared COVID-19 emergency, the City Council Chamber and City Hall are closed to the public. Consistent with State of California Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the Los Angeles County Health Officer’s “Safer at Home Order for Control of COVID-19” the City Council will participate in the meeting through teleconference. Public participation in the meeting will be facilitated through the electronic methods as described below.
Agenda Materials:
The agenda and agenda packet related to items on this agenda are available for public inspection at www.cerritos.us. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet will be made available for public inspection at www.cerritos.us.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION:
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us and on Cerritos TV3.
Public Comments:
Members of the public may provide public comment through the following methods:
Email: Members of the public may provide public comment by submitting an email to city_clerk@cerritos.us by 5:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the meeting date and agenda item number for which you would like to provide comment in the subject line of the email. The public comment will be distributed to all members of the City Council. During the meeting your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Teleconference Participation: You may provide audio public comment by connecting to the teleconference meeting online or by telephone/mobile call (please select only one method). Public speakers will be queued to provide comment at the appropriate time on the agenda. You must be available to provide comment at the time your connection is “unmuted.” If you are not planning on providing public comment we encourage you to observe the meeting via livestream or on Cerritos TV3 to allow staff to more effectively manage the number of teleconference connections.
Cerritos Zoom meeting online link: https://us04web.zoom.us/j/72720584075
Cerritos Zoom Meeting call-in telephone number: 1 (669) 900-6833
Cerritos Zoom Meeting ID: 727 2058 4075
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations:
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the teleconference meeting.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
THURSDAY, APRIL 23, 2020, 7:00 P.M.

MINUTES OF AN ADJOURNED SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD
ON THURSDAY, APRIL 23, 2020, 7:00 P.M. (JOINT ITEM 9E/5A ON THIS AGENDA)
(Meeting was originally held on Monday, April 20, 2020, 2:00 P.M. and adjourned to
Thursday, April 23, 2020, 7:00 p.m. to be held concurrently with the Thursday, April 23,
2020, 7:00 p.m. Regular Meeting of the Cerritos City Council and the Successor Agency to
the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency – Please reference the Monday, April 20, 2020, 2:00
p.m. Special City Council/Successor Agency for additional information)

MEETINGS WERE HELD PURUSANT TO TELECONFERENCE AUTHORIZED BY STATE
OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20, VIA ZOOM VIDEO
COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID# 727 2058 4075

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Naresh Solanki.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Grace Hu
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Chuong Vo
  Mayor/Chair Naresh Solanki

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Hu, to excuse Council/Agency
  Member Edwards from the meeting (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Edwards (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

5.  Presentations/Appointments

  None.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Tobi Balma spoke regarding City Council conduct.

  Mel Cortez inquired as to Town Hall meetings sponsored by individual
  Councilmembers.
 City of Cerritos  April 23, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 7

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions (continued)

  Daisy Legasca spoke regarding Town Hall meetings and uniformity of Council
  procedures.

  Sam Desai spoke regarding a new local newspaper.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor declared
  the public comments period closed.

7.  Consent Calendar

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of
  April 9, 2020 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Hu, and seconded by Vo, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of April 9, 2020
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Edwards (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands

7B.1. Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated April 23, 2020
  (COUNCIL).

  This item was pulled from the Consent Calendar for separate consideration by
  Mayor Pro Tem Vo.

  MOTION: It was moved by Hu, and seconded by Vo, to approve the Register of
  Demands, as follows:

  City of Cerritos  4/23/2020  $8,324,941.61 (COUNCIL)

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Edwards (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

  None.
 City of Cerritos  April 23, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 7

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of the City’s response to the COVID-19 local emergency.

  Director of Emergency Services Executive Order 2020-01 issued on April 13, 2020
  (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Annie Hylton, City & Theater Marketing Manager/City
  Librarian. A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Sophia Tse inquired as to City efforts to help residents who require assistance.

  Murali Vasudevan inquired as to City tracking of Cerritos COVID-19 cases and
  requested more updates from the City to the public.

  Mel Cortez spoke regarding communication about a known COVID-19 case involving
  a deputy temporarily assigned to the Cerritos Sheriff Station.

  Daisy Legasca expressed concern regarding COVID-19 and the Farmer’s Market and
  requested that the Senior Center provide masks and gloves to seniors.

  Anantha Narayan expressed concern regarding COVID-19 and the Farmer’s Market.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor declared
  the public comments period closed.

  There was no further action taken on this item.

9B.  Review and consideration of a proposal to extend two (2) existing ground lease
  agreements between the City of Cerritos and Verizon Wireless, in connection with
  Verizon Wireless' use and lease of portions of City-owned property located at Liberty
  Park and Cerritos Park East for wireless telecommunications facility purposes
  (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kristin Aguila, Advance Planning Manager. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened public comments.

  Tobi Balma inquired as to the limitations of Internet and cable TV that the lease
  agreement may incur.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor declared
  the public comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Hu, and seconded by Vo, to authorize the City Manager, or
  his designee, to execute, acknowledge, and consent to the lease documentation for
  the lease of portions of City-owned property located at Liberty Park and Cerritos Park
  East for two (2) wireless telecommunication facilities, in such form as approved by
  the City Attorney and as the City Manager shall deem appropriate, including
  amendments to the lease agreements, and all related documents required or
  appropriate in connection with the completion of these lease transactions
  (COUNCIL).
 City of Cerritos  April 23, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 4 of 7

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9B.  (continued)

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Edwards (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

9C.  Review and consideration of a request by LRJ Automotive LLC, DBA Penske Jaguar
  Land Rover Cerritos, for the City of Cerritos to defer ground lease rent payments
  for a period of three (3) months due to the adverse financial implications
  presented by the COVID-19 pandemic (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kristin Aguila, Advance Planning Manager.
  A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened public comments.

  Mel Cortez inquired as to whether the rent deferral will affect City employees.

  Norma Williamson spoke regarding the business’ relationship and reciprocity with
  the City and the Cerritos community.

  Anantha Narayan expressed support for the City’s support of the local businesses
  and inquired as to the fiscal impact of the rent deferral.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor declared
  the public comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Hu, and seconded by Vo, to authorize the City Manager,
  or his designee, to execute a Rent Deferral Agreement between the City of
  Cerritos and LRJ Automotive LLC, dba Penske Jaguar Land Rover Cerritos, and any
  related documentation to defer ground lease rent pursuant to the following rent
  deferral terms, in such form approved by the City Manager and the City Attorney:

  1. Rent Deferral Term: A period not to exceed three (3) consecutive
  months – July 1, 2020 through September 30, 2020
  2. Total Rent Deferred: $70,101.00 (current rent: $23,367.00 monthly)
  3. Payback Terms:
   Payback to begin six (6) months after the deferral end date (April 1,
  2021)
   Payback shall be within a period of twelve (12) months and/or no later
  than April 1, 2022, interest free
   Payments can be made monthly along with regularly scheduled ground
  rent payments, in one lump-sum, or a combination of both
   Penalty for non-payment: If full payment is not received by April 1,
  2022, payment shall be required with the addition of 15% interest on
  the outstanding balance

  (COUNCIL).
 City of Cerritos  April 23, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 5 of 7

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9C.  (continued)

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Edwards (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

9D.  Review and consideration of a request by Sheraton Cerritos Hotel for the City of
  Cerritos to defer ground lease rent payments for a period of six (6) months due to
  the adverse financial implications presented by the COVID-19 pandemic
  (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kristin Aguila, Advance Planning Manager.
  A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Murali Vasudevan expressed support for the City’s accommodations to Cerritos
  businesses and inquired as to the City’s plan for future rent deferral or forgiveness
  requests.

  Norma Williamson spoke regarding the Sheraton Cerritos Hotel and efforts to use
  the hotel for healthcare workers and first responder accommodations during the
  COVID-19 crisis.

  Daisy Legasca spoke regarding the Sheraton Cerritos Hotel and efforts to use the
  hotel for healthcare workers and first responder accommodations during the
  COVID-19 crisis.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor declared
  the public comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Vo, and seconded by Hu, to authorize the City Manager,
  or his designee, to execute a Rent Deferral Agreement between the City of Cerritos
  and Crown Jewel of Pacifica, LLC, and any related documentation to defer ground
  lease rent pursuant to the following terms, in such form approved by the City Manager
  and the City Attorney:

  1. Rent Deferral Term: A period not to exceed six (6) consecutive months –
  April 1, 2020 through September 30, 2020
  2. Total Rent Deferred: $67,291.00 (current rent: $33,645.50 per quarter)
  3. Payback Terms:
   Payback to begin six (6) months after the deferral end date (April 1,
  2021)
   Payback shall be within a period of twelve (12) months and/or no later
  than April 1, 2022, interest free
   Payments can be made monthly along with regularly scheduled ground
  rent payments, in one lump-sum, or a combination of both
   Penalty for non-payment: If full payment is not received by April 1,
  2022, payment shall be required with the addition of 15% interest on
  the outstanding balance

  (COUNCIL).
 City of Cerritos  April 23, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 6 of 7

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9D.  (continued)

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Edwards (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

JOINT ITEM 9E AND 5A - Item 5A from the Monday, April 20, 2020, 2:00 p.m.
Special Meeting Agenda was adjourned to Thursday, April 23, 2020, 7:00 p.m.
and was heard concurrently with Item 9E on this agenda.

9E.  Review and consideration to reduce the increasing deficit of the Fiscal Year 2019-
  20 Combined Financial Budget in response to the COVID-19 emergency
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

5A.  Review and consideration to reduce the increasing deficit of the Fiscal Year 2019-
  20 Combined Financial Budget in response to the COVID-19 emergency
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  A staff report on restricted and unrestricted City funds was given by Mark Steres,
  City Attorney. A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  A staff report on the OpenGov Transparency Portal was given by Aaron Benjamin,
  Information Technology Manager. A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  A staff report on the projected loss of revenue and an update on the status of the
  City Enterprise Funds was given by Ryan Carey, Finance Manager. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  A staff report on City personnel and salary information was given by Patricia Leyva,
  Personnel/Risk Manager. A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  A staff report on proposed budget expenditure reductions, budget totals, and
  budget summaries was given by Jeff Thielke, Budget Manager. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  A staff report on the Cerritos Electric Utility was given by Kanna Vancheswaran,
  Director of Public Works/Water & Power. A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Daisy Legasca stated that she will ask questions at the next meeting.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor declared
  the public comments period closed.

  City Council and staff discussion ensued regarding various strategies to address
  the increasing deficit of the Fiscal Year 2019-2020 Combined Financial Budget
  in response to accelerated economic impacts due to the COVID-19 emergency.
  The City Council requested that staff provide additional information related to
  the City’s current and future financial position and provide proposals for cost
  reductions and revenue enhancements.
 City of Cerritos  April 23, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 7 of 7

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9E.  (continued)

  MOTION: It was moved by Vo, and seconded by Solanki, to continue agenda item
  9E and individual City Council reports on item 11 to the May 11, 2020 Special City
  Council/Successor Agency Meeting (COUNCIL/SUCCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Edwards (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation.

  None.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or
  Federal legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.

  None.

11.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings

  This item was continued to the May 11, 2020 Special City Council/Successor
  Agency Meeting.

12.  Closed Session

  None.

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 11:25 p.m.
